items.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Planting Spyware Device in an Executive Conference Room
items.description: An OpenAI engineer has been arrested for allegedly hiding an audio recording device in an executive conference room at the company’s San Francisco offices. Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, a Saudi national, was arrested on October 9, 2026, and appeared in federal court on October 13, according to the U.S. Department of Justice.
